espei_phase_rule: Physical phase rule (tools/phase_rule.py): a literature value is assigned to a phase only when the paper names that phase (printed phase label of the value; when no label is printed, a table caption that names the liquid) and the phase registry maps the label to a model phase; no default phase is assigned. A liquid assignment must be physically possible: not below the lowest liquid temperature of any calculated SGTE diagram of the system minus max(100 K, 10 %) (twice that for printed invariant and phase-composition records; no calculated diagram: not below 0.40 x the lowest element melting point). Formation enthalpies and entropies of a stoichiometric compound go to that compound's TDB endmember (ESPEI non-equilibrium dataset, `solver`); other properties of a compound are not used in ESPEI. A solution-phase assignment outside the phase's field in the calculated diagram of the target TDB is flagged (`outside_calculated_field`), not excluded.
